scope: 32 discrete normal-Ninten Sprite.frame animation tracks; not Player or AnimationTree compatibility
out_of_duration_keys: Idle Right has a 0.1s loop with original keys at 8..12.9s. Preserve all keys and compare actual engine playback; do not delete them as malformed or change source expectations.
licence_review: Pinned upstream LICENSE permits source assets for game-related forks/modifications/translations. Ninten frame data and the source texture are used only for this Mother: Encore port; this does not relicense game assets as MIT. No environment fonts/images or third-party game binaries are used.
visibility_tracks: Run has only Position/main:frame and must preserve both visibility properties. Idle, Walk and Crouch set main true and SpecialAnimations false at time zero.
discrete_playback: Godot 3.6.2 AnimationPlayer uses float clock and [from,to) discrete events. Events exactly at the new time normally apply on the next advance; zero-delta seeks and exact loop multiples have explicit engine exceptions. Scoped implementation maps these rules, not interpolated frame sampling.
